limitations_and_integrity: Local origin/near-critical parameter result for only k=2,s=4. No claim about more distant cycles or other k; historical priority requires independent assessment. Verification is analytic, with exact algebra and numerical crosschecks, without independent audit.
scientific_claim: At \(m=1/3\), the field \(\dot x=y^3-x^5,\;\dot y=-x+m y^9\) has \(P_{1/3}(\rho)-\rho=I\rho^{22}+O(\rho^{29})\), where \(I=(158\sqrt{2}/49725)\mathrm B(3/4,1/2)>0\). For \(m=1/3-\delta\), small \(\delta>0\), an unstable hyperbolic local cycle has amplitude \(\rho_\delta\sim(K\delta/I)^{1/14}\), with \(K=(15\sqrt{2}/77)\mathrm B(1/4,1/2)\), and original-time period \(\sim\sqrt 2\,\mathrm B(1/4,1/2)/\rho_\delta\).
title: Critical repulsion and a \(1/14\)-law for cycles in a nilpotent polynomial oscillator
